access_grants_subject_id_ck.name: access_grants_subject_id_ck
access_grants_subject_id_ck.value: ("access_grants"."subject_type" = 'everyone' AND "access_grants"."subject_id" IS NULL) OR ("access_grants"."subject_type" <> 'everyone' AND "access_grants"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL)

memories_scope_ck.name: memories_scope_ck
memories_scope_ck.value:
("memories"."visibility" = 'private' AND "memories"."owner_person_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("memories"."visibility" = 'team' AND "memories"."team_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("memories"."visibility" = 'agent_wide')
